A '''tomb''' built by the [[House of Tion/Legends|House of Tion]] was sealed by a complex locking mechanism until the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], when schematics were found that explained the mechanics of the lock.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Death's Intricate Door}}</ref>
